timing_scope: 50-MHz core checked. External asynchronous slow probe pins to input synchronizers excepted. Analog levels, 100-kHz I2C and TMDS are not proven by this probe.
connection: Disconnect PC and monitor. Connect the same secondary board's HDMIA to HDMIB with one ordinary HDMI cable. No adapters, injected voltages or enclosure removal.
operation: Load through JTAG only. Eight 0.5-second static-level tests; KEY1 restarts. After completion alternate F0 mask, E0 local/remote low-stage snapshot, E1 local/remote high-stage snapshot, F0 mask. Successful pages F0FF/E000/E111. Digital pass is not PC/video/audio pass.
previous_raw_board_result: 1AE4B230: user repeatedly reports F97U, LED2 on, LED3/4 off. Probe ADC mistakenly mapped segment bits 4/5/6 to A8/A7/B5 instead of B5/A8/A7; actual F07D renders F97U. F07D is consistent with the LED result: HPD low passes, HPD high fails, independent SCL/SDA checks pass; final all-high check also fails. Do not decode it as F097.
display_mapping_fix: Restore the board-passed segment pin table and add a build-time comparison against relay ADC; verified that an injected segment-location typo is rejected.
hpd_readback: Explicit IOTRIBUF mapped to J6 BI PAD, ts=0, input diq to pins_ff1[5]. It measures the local digital PAD level rather than the internal request; does not measure voltage at the connector/PC. First failure or last successful sample is retained for each HPD stage.
leds: LED1 heartbeat; LED2 complete; LED3 HPD tests 0/1 pass; LED4 independent DDC tests 2..6 pass. Final test7 includes HPD and no longer contaminates LED4.
